title: Inhabitation and selection of margin-retaining exchange-stable Ds states
statement: On the DS15/DS16 class: (a) INHABITATION - do margin-compatible one-point exchange-stable sequences exist almost surely as N -> oo (is DS16's certificate branch non-vacuous asymptotically), and is the margin-compatible optimum v*(kappa) attained by margin-compatible population-stationary rules (ties into C2 attainment)? Measured: margin-retaining non-global stable states exist in every census instance at N <= 14 (CE-DS-STABLE-MARGIN-RETAINING-001), but every free-ascent terminal at N = 100..1000 is in the funnel. (b) SELECTION - does exchange ascent from the documented seeds (efficient-score labels, k-means, random) converge in value to v_K almost surely, so that the DS16 funnel forces terminal degeneracy? Measured yes through N = 1000, seed-independently. (c) DESIGN - a margin-constrained exchange (accept only moves keeping lambda_min >= kappa, or a penalized/certified relaxation) that terminates at certified states with a stated gap to v*(kappa), feeding OP7's certified-solver programme.
